sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Each example contains the correction, not just the answer.

items.prompt: A line has equation y = 2x - 1. Which of these equations represents a line parallel to it?

steps: Parallel lines have the same slope but different y-intercepts.
y = 2x + 4 has slope 2, the same as y = 2x - 1, but a different intercept.
So y = 2x + 4 is parallel to the given line.

items.prompt: A line has equation y = 2x + 1. Write the equation of the line through (3, 4) that is parallel to this line.

steps: A parallel line has the same slope, 2.
Use y = 2x + b and the point (3, 4): 4 = 2(3) + b.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Before solving, say which error the problem is testing for.

items.prompt: A plant's height is given by H = 7w + 9, where H is the height in centimeters and w is the number of weeks since it was measured. What does the slope represent in this context?
choices: The plant was 7 centimeters tall when it was first measured.
The plant grows 7 centimeters per week.
The plant grows 9 centimeters per week.
The plant was 9 centimeters tall when it was first measured.

items.prompt: A taxi fare is given by F = 8m + 11, where F is the total fare in dollars and m is the number of miles traveled. What does the y-intercept represent in this context?
choices: The fare increases by $11 for each additional mile traveled.
There is a base fare of $11 before any miles are traveled.
There is a base fare of $8 before any miles are traveled.
The fare increases by $8 for each additional mile traveled.

items.prompt: Find the slope of the line through (3, 1) and (8, 10).

A line passes through these points:
x: 0, 1, 2, 3
y: 6, -2, -10, -18
What is the slope (rate of change) of the line?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A line passes through (-8, 12). A slope triangle on the line has a horizontal leg (run) of 5 and a vertical leg (rise) of 2. A similar slope triangle further along the same line is 2 times as large. Which point also lies on the line?
A line has a slope of -6. A right triangle drawn along the line has a vertical leg (rise) of 25 units. What is the length of the other leg?
Write the equation, in slope-intercept form, of a line with slope -10 and y-intercept -14.
Identify the slope and y-intercept of the line y = 12x + 14.
